mapper.insert: insert into tb_campus_want (user_id, goods_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from tb_campus_want where user_id = #{userId} and goods_id = #{goodsId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from tb_campus_want where user_id = #{userId} and goods_id = #{goodsId}
select goods_id from tb_campus_want where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
select count(1) from tb_campus_want where user_id = #{userId}
